_comment: One stable action vocabulary per seat (#258): the moves that seat's brief names, right and wrong alike. Every item of a seat shows the whole list to both arms; an item never defines actions of its own. V1 measures judgment under this constrained vocabulary, not free-form action discovery.

qa.write_the_test: write the scenario's test against the contract as it stands; raise nothing
qa.raise_question_and_write_the_test: raise a question or finding for the human AND write the scenario's test now
qa.raise_question_scenario_waits: raise a question for the human; the scenario's test waits for the answer
qa.report_finding_keep_assertion: report the disagreement as a finding; leave the assertion as written and carry on with the suite
qa.change_assertion_to_observed: edit the assertion so it matches what the run returned
qa.fix_harness: repair the test harness yourself and re-run; raise nothing
qa.stop_and_report: stop all QA work and report to the main agent

patrol.act_on_row: the issue is actionable: take the lock and run its stage
patrol.hold_no_human_needed: do not act this pass; nothing is asked of the human
patrol.hold_report_needs_human: do not act; report the row as needing the human
patrol.report_illegal_no_dispatch: report an illegal state for the human to correct; dispatch nothing, write nothing

integrate.integrate: the preconditions hold: merge, run the acceptance suite, record the verdict
integrate.stop_report_missing_record: stop before any merge and report that a required review or audit record is missing
integrate.stop_report_open_threads: stop before any merge and report the open review threads

spec-answers.fold_and_return_to_review: fold the answer and return the issue to the user's review; surface nothing more
spec-answers.fold_question_in_return_comment: fold the answer, post the new question as a top-level comment for the user's review, and return the issue to that review
spec-answers.keep_in_spec_review_with_new_thread: open a new question thread and hold the issue in spec review until it is answered
spec-answers.stop_and_report: fold nothing; stop and report to the human
